import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/root/nocodb-data/noco.db')
tbl=[r[0] for r in c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and (name like '%base_users%' or name like '%project_users%')\")]
print('таблиці доступів:', tbl)
for t in tbl:
    cols=[x[1] for x in c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(%s)'%t)]
    print('---',t,cols)
    for row in c.execute('select * from %s'%t):
        print('   ', dict(zip(cols,row)))
users={r[0]:r[1] for r in c.execute('select id,email from nc_users_v2')}
print('користувачі:', users)
